{{Quote|The best Jedi realize that their training never ends.|Halacia|<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] players of ''The Old Republic'' can interact with Halacia independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the interaction must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>}}
'''Halacia''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Halacia wore yellow and white [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]], and alongside Master [[Arias]], they were stationed in the [[Promenade]]&mdash;an entertainment and shopping complex on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> Halacia spoke with the future [[Hero of Tython]], stating that the Force would fight alongside the Jedi Knight, and that the best [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would find that their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] would never cease. They also taught the Jedi new [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], saying that what the latter learned from her could protect the life of the Knight and the lives of others.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|What you learn here could save your life and others.|Halacia speaks to the player character|<ref name="date" />}}
Halacia appears as a Jedi Knight trainer in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" /> However, they and Arias were excluded from the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', which included the placements of the four Imperial classes as well as the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] and [[Republic trooper|Trooper]] trainers on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
